description: This PHP source file defines a class `tracxmlrpcInterface` which implements an interface for interacting with a Trac issue tracker via XML-RPC. It includes methods for connecting to the system, retrieving issue details, checking issue ID syntax, and managing configuration for the system.

classes.name: tracxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to communicate with a Trac issue tracker through XML-RPC, including methods for connection, issue retrieval, and configuration.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client object used for XML-RPC communication.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the given bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Trac XML-RPC server.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the class is currently connected to the issue tracker.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches and returns detailed information about a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the human-readable status of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the issue's summary formatted as an HTML string, optionally decorated.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Verifies whether an issue with the specified ID exists.

methods.name: createAPIClient
methods.description: Initializes the XML-RPC client for communication with Trac.

methods.name: sendCmd
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC command to the Trac server and returns the response.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration string for setting up a new issue tracker connection.
